description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between layer and similarity for four different configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Similarity” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.45, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. 

The line representing “en&en” is colored red, uses a solid line style, and begins at a similarity of approximately 0.08 at layer 0, increasing to a peak of 0.28 at layer 5, then decreasing to 0.12 at layer 14, and finally rising to 0.43 at layer 22. The line for “en&es” is colored light blue, uses a solid line style, and starts at a similarity of approximately 0.05 at layer 0, gradually increasing to 0.16 at layer 10, then decreasing to 0.08 at layer 18, and rising to 0.23 at layer 22. The line representing “en&el” is colored green, uses a solid line style, and begins at a similarity of approximately 0.03 at layer 0, increasing to a peak of 0.14 at layer 4, then decreasing to 0.07 at layer 18, and rising to 0.11 at layer 22. Finally, the line for “en&bn” is colored purple, uses a solid line style, and starts at a similarity of approximately 0.05 at layer 0, remaining relatively stable around 0.07 until layer 18, and then increasing sharply to 0.41 at layer 22.
